items.note: Compares robot controllers that participants coded with versus without an LLM coding assistant, scoring robustness and similarity (homogeneity) of the produced controllers; coding is a borderline creative task, and the abstract gives neither assignment nor N.

Pre-registered online study in which participants post-edit LLM drafts and also write unassisted control texts; embedding-based style measures show lower stylistic diversity across people for post-edited text (within-person design; order randomization not stated).

Participants co-write stories with pro- or anti-stereotypical single-word LM suggestions; the scored outcome is stereotype content of stories, not creativity or diversity (CHI 2026 version of arXiv 2409.20390).

Expert interviews followed by an egg-task experiment comparing ideation with and without GenAI tools; outcomes are number of ideas and fixation/exploration of ideas; conditions, assignment, and N not in the abstract.

Field experiment with 99 knowledge workers at a multinational firm comparing outputs made with versus without GenAI on three tasks; outputs with GenAI were more homogeneous in style and content (abstract from OpenAlex; OpenAlex misfiles venue).

Co-creative story writing with a dissenting versus a conforming AI; stories were more creative with the dissenting AI but not significantly; abstract text only from search snippet of the researchr/ICCC 2025 listing (pp. 92-96), N unknown and likely small; a related Leiden thesis (theses.liacs.nl 2024-2025-BouterDDavid) may hold details.

Two student design workshops, one ChatGPT-assisted (n=22) and one analogue (n=17), scored on fluency, flexibility, and originality; assignment is by workshop, below 50 participants; follow-up to the E&PDE 2024 pilot (c724), sample appears different.

Pilot with 35 undergraduates in two workshops (ChatGPT-assisted versus analogue team ideation) scored on fluency, flexibility, and originality; assignment is by workshop, below 50 participants; earlier pilot of c723.

DesignAID tool study with 87 crowd designers comparing LLM-to-image generation with Pinterest image search at high and low idea diversity; outcomes are designers' own ratings of inspiration, enjoyment, and usefulness, not scored output (Rick et al. 2025 may report a related larger sample).

Randomized experiment with 976 managers comparing an agentic multi-agent AI system, general AI (GPT-4o), and no AI on building strategic theories; outcome is rated quality of the strategies, so creativity fit (idea generation versus decision quality) needs a check at full text.
